HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K. SREENIVASA REDDY  Criminal Petition No.2099 of 2023 Order:

This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 Cr.P.C., has been filed on behalf of the petitioner/A-4, to quash the proceedings in Crime No.14 of 2023 of Disha UPS, Nellore, SPSR Nellore district, registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing for some time,
has confined his argument to the extent of protecting the petitioner herein from the police.

3. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor contended that specific accusations have been made as against the petitioner herein and truth or otherwise of the said accusations has to be gone into by the investigating agency.

Since the accusations that have been made in the FIR as against the petitioner herein can be gone into by the investigating agency, this Court, in a petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., would not be in a position to go into the disputed questions of fact and quash the Jayanthi Siva Naga Jyothi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192408572/
1 proceedings at this stage.

sentences.text:
2 6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case,
this Court is not inclined to quash the proceedings against the petitioner herein.
However, the police concerned are directed to conduct investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioner herein/A-4 only, including her arrest.
7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
8. As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

K. SREENIVASA REDDY, J.
